Mstar_source: config/malanga/lupus_TableA1_Mstar_Hof.csv (Malanga et al. 2026 Table A.1, 65 measured M*, bootstrap, exact values)
star_source: config/malanga/BHAC15_iso_0.5Myr_Hof.csv (BHAC15, 0.5 Myr isochrone, linear interpolation in log-log)

grid_rule.formula: r_min = max(min(R_T, 0.16 R0), 0.03 au), R_T = Konigl (1991) Eq. 1 with B* (equatorial) and beta above, each disc's M*, R* and Mdot0_est (Tabone et al. 2022 Eq. 42); r_max = min(400 R0, 1000 au); nr from the config

psi_floor: psi_DW = max(alpha_DW / alpha_SS - 1, 0); floored discs: e_rad = 1, lambda = inf (no wind)
R0_rule: R0 < 0.03 au (the r_min floor) is clipped to 0.03 au (flag_R0_clipped); then r_min <= R0
lambda_rule: Balogh et al. (2026) Eq. 16 with e_rad from relation D (xi from Malanga Eq. 6)
